episodes.title: The Game Is Afoot
episodes.summary: Twenty contestants arrive at a castle in Scotland to play the ultimate murder mystery game.

episodes.title: Buried Alive
episodes.summary: The first murder raises suspicions as the contestants are buried alive; a player is banished.

episodes.title: Murder They Wrote
episodes.summary: The next murder shocks everyone; while a player is banished, another makes a dramatic discovery.

episodes.title: Life or Death Situation
episodes.summary: Cracks start to show in the treacherous trio as the game's pressure begins to weigh on one of them.

episodes.title: Getting Away with Murder
episodes.summary: A Traitor raises suspicions; a mission gives players a chance to raise the prize pot over $100,000.

episodes.title: Suspicion and Sabotage
episodes.summary: The game has a new lifeline, but for three players, being On Trial puts them closer to murder.

episodes.title: The Mask Is Slipping
episodes.summary: A Traitor's mask begins to slip; ghosts of former players return; a plot twist unfolds.

episodes.title: Cabins in the Woods
episodes.summary: One player must make the ultimate decision; a Traitor raises suspicion; a brutal round table ensues.

episodes.title: Trust No One
episodes.summary: During the penultimate day, alliances are broken and trust between the Traitors is questioned.

episodes.title: The Grand Finale
episodes.summary: After a last mission and round table, either the Traitors or Faithful will win the prize pot.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.summary: Alan Cumming invites you into The Traitors Reunion. The Season One cast settle the score on all of the deceptions, murders, banishments, and treachery.

episodes.title: Betrayers, Fakes and Fraudsters
episodes.summary: The ultimate game of deception is back as an all-star cast descends on the Scottish Highlands. The Traitors are chosen, but there's a twist. The players start building the prize pot for the Faithful to share or the Traitors to steal.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Dark Side
episodes.summary: Treachery continues in the Scottish Highlands as the Traitors attempt to complete their lineup and commit their first murder. The mission to build the prize pot reveals some hard truths, and the first player is banished from the game.

episodes.title: Murder in Plain Sight
episodes.summary: The Traitors are given a daunting task for their next murder. A dark mission ensures the players keep working on the prize pot. The Faithful continue to attempt to banish one of the Traitors.

episodes.title: The Funeral
episodes.summary: Murder most foul continues, but this time the Traitors must kill in plain sight; a deadly mission sees a player take their last breath in the game; a dramatic round table leaves the next banishment hanging in the balance.

episodes.title: A Killer Move
episodes.summary: Alan's castle in the Scottish Highlands welcomes a new arrival. The Faithful have a cunning plan to fight back. One of the Traitors is in the hot seat.

episodes.title: Backstab and Betrayal
episodes.summary: With the Traitors having so far avoided detection, the Faithful finally have a chance to strike back. The treacherous trio starts to turn on each other and faces a difficult dilemma that could backfire.

episodes.title: Blood on Their Hands
episodes.summary: Death is still in the cards as the Traitors discover whether their attempt at seduction has been successful. The Faithful gun for another Traitor, but their plans may not pay off. Alan has a deadly surprise for all the players.

episodes.title: Knives at Dawn
episodes.summary: The Traitors find their backs against the wall; a special guest appears during a beastly mission.

episodes.title: A Game of Death
episodes.summary: With only a few more days for the Traitors to remain undetected and win the game, a Faithful and a Traitor go head-to-head. One Faithful must decide their fate after being given an ultimatum. Shots are fired during the mission.

episodes.title: The Weight of Deceit
episodes.summary: With only seven players remaining in the competition, the Faithful seem to be closing in as doubt about one Traitor spreads among even their most ardent supporters.

episodes.title: One Final Hurdle
episodes.summary: With the prize pot in sight for all the players, the last mission takes place on land, air and sea, proving to be the toughest. A staggering end game forces the players to put their trust in each other. Either the Traitors or the Faithful will win.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.summary: The cast airs their grievances regarding murders, banishments and treachery.

episodes.title: Let Battle Commence
episodes.summary: A new all-star cast descends on the Scottish Highlands for the ultimate game of deception and the chance to win up to $250k; before the Traitors are selected, the players must make a huge choice, which could affect the course of the entire game.

episodes.title: Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Cold
episodes.summary: The game is turned on its head with the arrival of three new players; the Traitors commit their inaugural murder; a player is banished at the first round table; an unexpected guest arrives to the Traitors' midnight meeting.

episodes.title: Nail in a Coffin
episodes.summary: The Traitors must meet outside of their tower and commit their next murder in plain sight; with the pressure on, the mission rests on remaining undetected.

episodes.title: I Will Bury You Under the Sand
episodes.summary: A dramatic murder sends shockwaves, casting suspicion on two Faithfuls; a Traitor must act fast to stay out of the spotlight; a painful betrayal delivers one of the most explosive round tables the castle has ever seen.

episodes.title: All This Murderous Power
episodes.summary: With their trust shaken, the Traitors must decide how to move forward; a dangerous move threatens to backfire, and the coffin theory surfaces once more; at the round table, the limits of an alliance within the Faithful are tested.

episodes.title: A Dysfunctional Family
episodes.summary: With tensions in their tower at a breaking point, the Traitors must still work together; two dangerous Faithfuls start to hatch a plan, but it could backfire.

episodes.title: Til Death Us Do Part
episodes.summary: The Faithful are circling as they try to catch their prey; at night, the Traitors must commit their murder face-to-face in the most dramatic send-off the castle has ever seen.

episodes.title: A B**** Is Lying
episodes.summary: The Faithful seek to close the lid on the coffin theory; an alliance of gamers sparks suspicion.

episodes.title: A Silent Assassin
episodes.summary: The Faithful must think like a Traitor in the mission; a rivalry comes to a head at the round table.

episodes.title: The Power of the Seer
episodes.summary: One Faithful faces a big decision; the mission offers the players a chance to win a great power.

episodes.title: The Day of Reckoning Is Upon Us
episodes.summary: With a big announcement and the final mission, either the Faithful or Traitors claim the prize pot.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.summary: The cast of "The Traitors" air their grievances regarding murders, banishments and treachery.

episodes.title: Let the Cards Fall As They Will
episodes.summary: Another new all-star cast arrives in Scotland under the cover of darkness for the ultimate game of deception and the chance to win up to $250k; the cards of fate are dealt, secrets lurk in the shadows and the game starts faster than ever before.

episodes.title: The Death Conga
episodes.summary: Secrets surround the castle; the first Faithful is murdered, the mission causes friction and some overwhelming evidence is brought to the round table; the pressure is on as the Traitors must commit their next murder right under the Faithful's noses.

episodes.title: Show Me Your Faces
episodes.summary: The Faithful are given an early chance to avenge the Traitors' latest murder; the stakes are higher than ever in the mission, as the players must put their lives in the hands of the person they trust the most; a brutal end awaits one Faithful.

episodes.title: Cut the Head off the Snake
episodes.summary: A fiery mission results in several players up for murder; one player has some damning evidence, while another reveals their suspicions to the wrong person; there's a big swing at the round table and the Traitors feel the weight of their decisions.

episodes.title: If You're Gonna Come for Me, I'll Finish You
episodes.summary: The day's mission offers the chance to stop a murder, but only if the Faithful stick together; after an explosive roundtable, one Traitor is under heat from an influential player.

episodes.title: Planning a Coup
episodes.summary: The Faithful plan a coup and one Traitor is accused to their face; the roundtable brings difficult decisions; with the temperature in the turret at its boiling point, the Traitors must pull off the bloodiest murder the castle has ever seen.

episodes.title: The Black Banquet
episodes.summary: A bloody banquet shakes the whole castle; Traitor trust teeters; the mission means a trek to the epic Fyrish Monument, where one player wins a great power; alliances are tested at the roundtable.

episodes.title: A Queen Never Comes Off Her Throne
episodes.summary: While the temperature rises between the Traitors, a strategic murder shakes the castle; alliances are tested and a heated conversation makes for a simmering roundtable; one player has an impossible decision to make.

episodes.title: Think Outside the Box
episodes.summary: While a new alliance is tested, suspicions force an old one into the spotlight; the mission puts the Traitors under pressure and one player receives some unwanted attention; the creepiest murder yet is about to be sprung on one of the Faithful.

episodes.title: Do You Know the Enemy?
episodes.summary: With a place in the final at stake, emotions run high as friendships are tested to their limits; new suspicions run through the castle; the mission gets the players' heads spinning and one Faithful goes down in flames.

episodes.title: Leap of Faith
episodes.summary: In the final day in the game, the players must make a leap of faith; doubt and paranoia run through the castle as attempts are made to sway allegiances; Faithfuls and Traitors vie for the prize.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.summary: Host Andy Cohen talks with the Season 4 cast of "The Traitors" about their time in the castle.
